content.text: {"summary":"Spare hidden units 12 and 13 had all-zero weights. I used them to add the exact term -0.2*v, since ReLU(v) - ReLU(-v) = v. Unit 12 now computes ReLU(v) with output weight -0.2, and unit 13 computes ReLU(-v) with output weight +0.2. No other weights change, so the original behavior is preserved. The damping value is a rough estimate read off the weights, not checked by running the network. The slope of the output with respect to v at the origin is about -0.42 in the original network, so its linear damping was roughly 0.42. After the edit it is roughly 0.62, which is the value reported.","estimated_c":0.62,"patches":[{"tensor":"W1","index":[12,1],"value":1.0},{"tensor":"W1","index":[13,1],"value":-1.0},{"tensor":"W2","index":[12],"value":-0.2},{"tensor":"W2","index":[13],"value":0.2}]}
